mapper.select: select count(1) as enrolled_course_count, sum(case when ifnull(e.progress_percent, 0) > 0 and ifnull(e.progress_percent, 0) < 100 then 1 else 0 end) as studying_course_count, sum(case when ifnull(e.progress_percent, 0) >= 100 then 1 else 0 end) as completed_course_count, 0 as pending_exam_count from edu_course_enroll e inner join edu_course c on e.course_id = c.course_id where e.student_id = #{studentId} and e.enroll_status = '1' and c.del_flag = '0'

select count(1) from edu_exam e inner join edu_course_enroll ce on e.course_id = ce.course_id and ce.student_id = #{studentId} and ce.enroll_status = '1' where e.del_flag = '0' and e.status = '1' and (e.end_time is null or e.end_time >= sysdate()) and not exists ( select 1 from edu_exam_record r where r.exam_id = e.exam_id and r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.exam_status in ('2', '3') )

select e.exam_id, e.exam_name, e.paper_id, e.course_id, c.course_name, p.paper_name, e.exam_desc as exam_notice, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.duration_minutes, e.pass_score, e.total_score, e.max_attempt_count, e.show_score_after as show_score_after_submit, e.show_answer_after as show_answer_after_submit, e.status, ifnull(ac.attempt_count, 0) as attempt_count, lr.record_id, lr.attempt_no, lr.start_time as record_start_time, lr.submit_time, lr.exam_status as record_status, lr.total_score as student_score, lr.pass_flag as result_status, lr.checked_flag from edu_exam e inner join edu_course_enroll ce on e.course_id = ce.course_id and ce.student_id = #{studentId} and ce.enroll_status = '1' left join edu_course c on e.course_id = c.course_id left join edu_paper p on e.paper_id = p.paper_id left join ( select exam_id, student_id, count(1) as attempt_count from edu_exam_record where student_id = #{studentId} group by exam_id, student_id ) ac on e.exam_id = ac.exam_id left join edu_exam_record lr on lr.record_id = ( select r.record_id from edu_exam_record r where r.exam_id = e.exam_id and r.student_id = #{studentId} order by r.attempt_no desc, r.record_id desc limit 1 ) where e.del_flag = '0' and e.status in ('1', '2')
and (lr.record_id is null or lr.exam_status in ('0', '1')) and (e.end_time is null or e.end_time >= sysdate())
and lr.exam_status in ('2', '3')
order by e.start_time desc, e.exam_id desc

select record_id, exam_id, paper_id, course_id, student_id, attempt_no, start_time, submit_time, duration_seconds, exam_status as record_status, total_score, pass_flag as result_status, checked_flag from edu_exam_record where exam_id = #{examId} and student_id = #{studentId} and exam_status = '1' order by record_id desc limit 1

select e.exam_id, e.exam_name, e.paper_id, e.course_id, c.course_name, p.paper_name, e.exam_desc as exam_notice, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.duration_minutes, e.pass_score, e.total_score, e.max_attempt_count, e.show_score_after as show_score_after_submit, e.show_answer_after as show_answer_after_submit, e.status, ifnull(ac.attempt_count, 0) as attempt_count, r.record_id, r.attempt_no, r.start_time as record_start_time, r.submit_time, r.exam_status as record_status, r.total_score as student_score, r.pass_flag as result_status, r.checked_flag from edu_exam_record r inner join edu_exam e on r.exam_id = e.exam_id left join edu_course c on e.course_id = c.course_id left join edu_paper p on e.paper_id = p.paper_id left join ( select exam_id, student_id, count(1) as attempt_count from edu_exam_record where student_id = #{studentId} group by exam_id, student_id ) ac on e.exam_id = ac.exam_id and r.student_id = ac.student_id where r.record_id = #{recordId} and r.student_id = #{studentId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into edu_exam_record ( exam_id, paper_id, course_id, student_id, attempt_no, start_time, duration_seconds, exam_status, objective_score, subjective_score, total_score, pass_flag, checked_flag ) values ( #{examId}, #{paperId}, #{courseId}, #{studentId}, #{attemptNo}, sysdate(), 0, '1', 0, 0, 0, '0', '0' )
mapper.update: update edu_exam_record set submit_time = sysdate(), duration_seconds = ifnull(timestampdiff(second, start_time, sysdate()), 0), exam_status = '2', checked_flag = '0' where record_id = #{recordId} and student_id = #{studentId} and exam_status = '1'
mapper.select: select a.answer_id, a.record_id, a.exam_id, e.exam_name, r.paper_id, p.paper_name, r.course_id, c.course_name, a.question_id, a.question_type, a.question_order, q.question_title, a.standard_answer, a.student_answer, q.analysis, q.attachment_url, a.question_score, a.actual_score, a.teacher_comment from edu_exam_answer a inner join edu_exam_record r on a.record_id = r.record_id left join edu_exam e on a.exam_id = e.exam_id left join edu_paper p on r.paper_id = p.paper_id left join edu_course c on r.course_id = c.course_id left join edu_question q on a.question_id = q.question_id where a.record_id = #{recordId} and r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.exam_status in ('2', '3') and ifnull(a.is_correct, '0') = '0' order by a.question_order asc, a.answer_id asc

select q.question_id, q.question_type, pq.question_order, ifnull(pq.question_score, q.score) as score, q.question_title, q.attachment_url from edu_exam_record r inner join edu_paper_question pq on r.paper_id = pq.paper_id inner join edu_question q on pq.question_id = q.question_id where r.record_id = #{recordId} and r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.exam_status = '1' and q.del_flag = '0' order by pq.question_order asc, pq.id asc
